note: Re-pinned 2026-07-21 by CofC ruling in the same change that armed --enforce. Previous baseline was 246, set 2026-07-19 from the reachability postmortem; the census drifted to 277 while the gate sat in observe and blocked nothing (+30 on 07-20/21 alone). Pinning at the CURRENT level rather than the old one is deliberate: the ratchet is on the DERIVATIVE, not the level, so no in-flight PR goes red for a pre-existing orphan and the existing graveyard blocks nobody. It may only go DOWN from here -- lower it with --update-baseline in the same PR that mounts or deletes a module. Do NOT raise it to make a red PR green; that is the one move that turns a ratchet back into a thermometer. A PR that adds a NEW unmounted router passes by mounting it OR by declaring it in tools/reachability_deferred.json with a one-line reason -- and autonomous build PRs now write that declaration themselves via zo_sentinel/publisher/auto_declare.py, because the publisher emits exactly one file and the builder cannot mount, which would otherwise have made this gate unsatisfiable for every builder PR. DEFERRED_COUNT added 2026-08-25 (MERGE_AUDIT_2026-08-23 G4): the deferred list is now NON-INCREASING and blocking. Pinned at the CURRENT 63, not the advisory cap of 40, for the same reason orphan_count was pinned at 277 -- the gate is on the derivative, so no in-flight PR goes red for a pre-existing deferral and the existing 63 need not be triaged first. It may only go DOWN: lower it with --update-baseline in the same PR that mounts or retires a deferred router. Raising it to make a red PR green is the move that turns this back into a thermometer.
